The '''NS-7 Guardian Droid''' was a [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] model used for security by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The model was bipedal and armed with a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]].
